title: Nonexceptional irreducible lisse sheaf (constituent form)
statement:
In the conventions of [rem-dl-a1-conventions], let
$j:U_0\hookrightarrow A_0=\mathbf A^1_{k_0}$ be a dense open immersion
and let $\mathcal M$ be a lisse Weil sheaf on
$U_0$, with geometric fundamental representation
$\rho_{\mathrm{geom}}:\pi_1(U,\bar\eta)\to\operatorname{GL}(V)$,
$V=\mathcal M_{\bar\eta}$, as in
[def-wf-fundamental-representation]. The *geometric irreducible
constituents* of $\mathcal M$ are the Jordan–Hölder constituents of
the $\pi_1(U,\bar\eta)$-module $V$, viewed as irreducible lisse sheaves
on $U=U_0\otimes k$.

$\mathcal M$ is *constituent-nonexceptional* if none of its geometric
irreducible constituents is isomorphic to the restriction
$\mathcal L_{\psi(ax)}|_U$ of the Artin–Schreier sheaf of
[def-fd-artin-schreier-sheaf] for any $a\in k$, the value $a=0$
included; for $a=0$ the excluded constituent is the trivial rank-one
sheaf $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$.
Here, for $a\in k$ (not only $a\in k_0$), $\mathcal L_{\psi(ax)}|_U$
is the sheaf $\mathcal L_{\psi,ax}$ on $U$ given by the construction of
[def-fd-artin-schreier-sheaf] applied to the global function
$ax\in\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_U)$, i.e. the pullback of
$\mathcal L_\psi$ on $\mathbf A^1_{k_0}$ along the morphism
$U\to\mathbf A^1_{k_0}$, $x\mapsto ax$.

lean.note: Section 1(B), repair of returned head 77186f4711e6: the prior IsNonexceptional takes the older WeilSheaf category and cannot be applied to recorded sfCommonStageWeilSheaf objects. The module retains that interface by public import and states constituent exclusion in the actual geometric common-stage heart, using lisse subquotients and the explicit completed Artin-Schreier line for every a in k, including zero. No geometric irreducibility or infinity condition is added.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q81-d9374271d (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: Read the item in full, its blueprint text (master order 2752, main-20261015 order 3096, main-20261017 identical) and the unit sk-p-dl-a1-middle sketch. Also read the cited nodes def-wf-fundamental-representation, def-fd-artin-schreier-sheaf (imported statement and BU), rem-dl-a1-conventions and def-fd-additive-character, and all six citers. The delivered statement is the BU verbatim. Its only change from master is dropping 'nonzero irreducible', which follows the current blueprint. Every citer states irreducibility itself, so no citer's meaning changes. The hypotheses of def-wf-fundamental-representation hold: U_0 is open in A^1 (separated, finite type) and U is connected. Coefficients are Q̄_ℓ throughout, and Jordan-Hölder constituents of the finite-dimensional continuous representation are well defined. def-fd-nonexceptional is a different notion (it applies to the whole middle extension) and lem-a1-constituent-nonexceptional-comparison compares the two, so it is not a duplicate. There are no new nodes and no proof steps. Two faults are repaired in fixes/dag/nodes/sec-deligne-laumon-a1/def-a1-constituent-nonexceptional.json. (1) B3: the statement cites [rem-dl-a1-conventions], now an imported definition node that supplies k_0, k, ℓ and lisse Weil sheaf, but it was missing from stmt_deps (dropped at import as a remark). I added it and checked that no cycle results. (2) B3/C4: def-fd-artin-schreier-sheaf defines L_{ψ(ax)} only for a∈k_0, but the item, and the Lean IsNonexceptional at MiddleExtension.lean:68-71, quantify over a∈k=k̄_0. This matters: a Galois orbit of L_{ψ(σ^i(a)x)} with a∉k_0 must count as exceptional. I added one sentence defining L_{ψ(ax)}|_U for a∈k as L_{ψ,ax}, the pullback of L_ψ along x↦ax, and checked it agrees with both forms of the cited construction. Small cases tested: zero sheaf, constant sheaf, L_{ψ(ax)} with a in k_0 and with a in k minus k_0, L_{ψ(x^2)}, Kummer sheaves, and non-semisimple extensions. No tool_uses.; 1 file(s) fixed by the reviewer
